name: Southwest Airlines
species: Small vaccinated domestic cats and dogs (at least 8 weeks old)
checked_or_cargo: No. Southwest does not transport pets in the cargo compartment.
banned_routes: No pets on international itineraries or on flights to/from Hawaii (inter-island flights allowed).
notes: One carrier per ticketed customer, up to two small cats or dogs of the same species per carrier. Pet Fare paid at the ticket counter; refundable if you cancel. The 'acceptable pet carriers' article did not render for our fetcher, so carrier dimensions are left unconfirmed.
